method: Share of posts that mention the skill in each sector, last 12 months against the 12 before. Sector = regex patterns over post text (data/sdg_sectors.json), perks and legal lines removed first. Baseline = all posts. lift = share / baseline share. reliable = at least 30 posts and 3 different employers tagged in the sector. employers_recent = distinct employers (first line of the post) behind the tagged posts; ci95 = Wilson interval. Counts, shares and thread URLs only.
